array.string: D=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date +%F); HH=$(TZ=Asia/Taipei date +%H:%M); TS="[$D $HH]"; LOG=/tmp/rockstock-youtube-status.log; ROOT=$HOME/Desktop/rockstock; VF=$ROOT/data/youtube/videos/$D.json; AF=$ROOT/data/youtube/analysis/$D.json; if [ ! -f "$VF" ]; then echo "$TS 今日 $D：尚無影片檔" >> "$LOG"; exit 0; fi; STATS=$(/usr/bin/python3 -c "import json,os; vids=json.load(open('$VF')); total=len(vids); az=[v for v in vids if v.get('should_analyze')]; tdir='$ROOT/data/youtube/transcripts/$D'; tids=set(); [tids.add(f.replace('.json','')) for f in os.listdir(tdir)] if os.path.isdir(tdir) else None; have=sum(1 for v in az if v['video_id'] in tids); print(f'{total} {len(az)} {have}')"); TOTAL=$(echo $STATS | awk '{print $1}'); ANALYZABLE=$(echo $STATS | awk '{print $2}'); TRANSCRIPTS=$(echo $STATS | awk '{print $3}'); if [ -f "$AF" ]; then AS="✅ 已寫"; else AS="⏳ 尚未寫"; fi; ACTION=""; if [ "$ANALYZABLE" -gt "$TRANSCRIPTS" ]; then PENDING=$((ANALYZABLE - TRANSCRIPTS)); ACTION=" → 觸發 transcript fetch（$PENDING 支待抓）"; /usr/bin/curl -fsS --max-time 280 -H "Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET" -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/cron/youtube-transcript?date=$D&use_whisper=1" > /dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2; fi; echo "$TS 今日 $D：影片 $TOTAL 支 / analyzable $ANALYZABLE 支 / transcript $TRANSCRIPTS 支 / analysis $AS$ACTION" >> "$LOG"
